purpose: Teach: 古墳/打破/祈祷/側近/優等生/邦画/長嶋/乱入

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、奈良時代の、本気で、絶対、古墳、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, your paper on Nara-era burial mounds was genuinely impressive. The depth of your research really struck me.
lines.style: Warm, steady admiration. Open with genuine recognition. Measured pace—giving each word room to land. Slight lift at the end, like she's inviting him to hear what she means.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。封建制度の、本気で、絶対、打破、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I really tried to dig deep into how feudal structures shaped those religious practices. I appreciate your feedback.
lines.style: Respectful, earnest. Slight hesitation before launching—gathering his words carefully. Quieter on the gratitude, not performative. Steady eye contact held briefly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 神道の、本気で、絶対、祈祷、絶対、儀式、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And the way you wove Shinto ritual into the broader historical picture—your perspective was really expansive. That took real intellectual courage.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost conversational. Leans slightly forward with the compliment. Warm but not effusive. The kind of teacher who means what she says and lets silence confirm it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。明治の元勲の、本気で、絶対、側近、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to understand how the Meiji oligarchs' inner circle influenced those same institutional patterns. That research took months.
lines.style: Humble but not self-diminishing. A thread of quiet pride underneath. Speaks as someone who knows he worked hard and trusts her to recognize it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 明治期の、本気で、絶対、優等生、絶対、教育、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The section on education during the Meiji period—how you connected it to state ideology—that was remarkable work.
lines.style: Direct praise delivered with steady warmth. No hesitation. Speaks like a teacher who has read this carefully and wants him to know it landed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦後の、本気で、絶対、邦画、絶対、復興、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I also traced how postwar cinema reflected those educational shifts and Japan's cultural reconstruction. That seemed like an important piece to include.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly softer. Acknowledges the scope without claiming credit. The kind of quiet confidence that comes from understanding your own work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: プロ野球の、本気で、絶対、長嶋、絶対、茂雄、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Even your tangent about Nagashima Shigeo and professional baseball—how you used it to illustrate postwar national identity—that was a bold choice.
lines.style: Genuine surprise threaded through warmth. Speaks like she's still processing how well he pulled off something unexpected. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴史上の、本気で、絶対、乱入、絶対、事件、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: That connection actually felt essential once I made it. Looking at how even sports figures became symbols of recovery and national pride—it tied the whole arc together.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. No apology for the scope. Speaks like someone who has thought this through carefully. Calm, grounded confidence at the close.
